units.source_text: "烟花女并非为了爱客才接客。

en.t: Prostitutes do not take customers because they love them.

units.source_text: 无论是老人、乞丐、独眼还是美男子，只要事先不知道，甚至连麻风病人她们也都接待。

en.t: Whether an old man, a beggar, a one-eyed man, or a handsome man, so long as they did not know beforehand, they would even receive a leper.

units.source_text: 要是一般人，也许会安于这种平等性，买个最初的女人吧。

en.t: An ordinary person might have been content with that equality and bought the first woman offered.

units.source_text: 然而，对我来说，这种平等性是不符合我的性格的。

en.t: For me, however, that kind of equality did not suit my nature.

units.source_text: 四肢健全的男子同这样一个我，都以同样的资格受到欢迎，这是我所不能容忍内。

en.t: That a man sound in all four limbs and someone like me should be welcomed on the same terms was something I could not endure.

units.source_text: 我认为，对我来说，这是可怕的冒渎。"

en.t: I thought that, for me, this was a terrible profanation."
